stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They realized that even adults and teachers can be beginners.”?
options: It became a lesson in problem-solving: when land, food, and cities change, people must imagine new ways to grow.
Old crops can carry traits that become valuable again under new conditions.
The first snow was not new to the village, but it became new again through Ms. Reed's eyes.
When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.
